basic_details.scholarship_name: Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University Full Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Saudi Ministry of Education & Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University (IMSIU, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University Main Campus (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to leading STEM, Computing, and Humanities colleges: College of Computer and Information Sciences (Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Security, Software Engineering), College of Science (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry), College of Engineering, College of Economics and Administrative Sciences, and Islamic Studies.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 400 to 600 international external scholarships awarded annually across all colleges under Saudi Government External Scholarships program
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Government bilateral country quota: 40 dedicated seats allocated annually for Pakistani citizens across degree levels
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor degree (plus 1 prep year if needed); 2 years for Master; 3 to 4 years for PhD, subject to maintaining good academic standing

nationality_requirements: Non-Saudi citizens residing outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (External Scholarship Program)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's applicants must be under 30 (or under 35 for specific STEM tracks); PhD applicants must be under 35 years old.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: For Undergraduate: Completed Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate) with minimum 75% marks (or 'Very Good' / Grade B+). For Master's: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Grading classification of 'Very Good' (Jayyid Jiddan) or higher in secondary school certificate.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering, Computer Science, or General Science background for College of Computer and Information Sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Must have graduated within the past 5 years from date of application.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Secondary school graduation certificate must not be older than 5 years at the time of application.

english_proficiency.notes: No standardized English test mandatory for general admissions; College of Computer and Information Sciences conducts coursework in English and accepts English Medium of Instruction certificates.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic language proficiency is NOT required for scientific and computing majors (instruction in English). Non-Arabic speakers admitted to Islamic/humanities majors undergo a 1-to-2 year intensive Arabic language preparatory diploma on campus.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female students must have an eligible Mahram (male guardian) who is also a student, worker, or resident in Saudi Arabia, unless Saudi regulations permit independent university hostel residency for international female scholarship recipients.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: International students from Islamic and partner countries under Saudi Ministry of Education bilateral quota.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicant must not have previously received a scholarship from another educational institution in Saudi Arabia.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver across all academic semesters, including preparatory year.

admission_application_fee.details: Application via Saudi Government Study in Saudi / Minhati portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free fully furnished university dormitory housing in IMSIU Student Housing Complex (Riyadh), with free utilities, air conditioning, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
accommodation.amount: Free university housing (~SAR 12,000 / year value; ~PKR 910,000 / yr)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid directly by Saudi Government: SAR 840/month for Undergraduate students (~PKR 64,000/mo); SAR 1,000/month for Master's and PhD students (~PKR 76,000/mo).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy class flight ticket provided between Pakistan (Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi) and Riyadh for annual summer vacation, plus initial arrival ticket.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Student Visa and residency permit (Iqama) issued free of charge through the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive free medical and dental care at IMSIU University Medical Center and Saudi government tertiary hospitals.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized nutritious meals provided at university central dining halls (meals cost ~SAR 3 to 5 per meal; ~PKR 220 to 380/meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual book allowance (equivalent to one month stipend) and thesis printing allowance of SAR 3,000 (Master) to SAR 4,000 (PhD) upon graduation.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: SAR 840 to 1,000 / year plus thesis grant

research_funding_conference_grant.details: IMSIU Deanship of Scientific Research funds laboratory materials and conference attendance for postgraduate researchers.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Funded by Deanship of Scientific Research

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free shuttle bus transportation connecting student residence halls, academic colleges, central library, and prayer halls.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single major comprehensive national university: Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia)
participating_institutions: Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University Main Campus (Riyadh)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 800 global university (QS World #751-760, top 25 in Arab World). World-renowned faculty in computing, information security, and sharia jurisprudence.
available_majors: College of Computer and Information Sciences: Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Security, Software Engineering
College of Science: Applied Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry
College of Engineering: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering
College of Economics and Administrative Sciences: Economics, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting
Arabic Language Teaching Institute: Intensive 2-Year Arabic Language Preparatory Diploma
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Undergraduate: 4 to 5 years (including preparatory year); Master: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Secondary school certificate with 75%+ marks, age 17-25 (undergrad) or under 35 (grad), medical fitness certificate, police clearance, and attested educational documents.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Computer and Information Sciences (Information Security / Cyber) has highest competitive cutoffs; College of Science and Arabic Language Institute have favorable quota availability.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply via the unified 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa) during the September-November window. Ensure all intermediate and matric documents are attested by IBCC and MOFA Pakistan before uploading.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Saudi Government Unified 'Study in Saudi' (Minhati) Portal & IMSIU Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the Saudi Ministry of Education unified portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa / minhati.moe.gov.sa), select Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University, choose desired major, and upload required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (July - August): Attest Matric and Intermediate certificates/degrees from IBCC and MOFA Pakistan; obtain Police Character Certificate and Medical Fitness Report.
Step 2 (September - November): Register on the 'Study in Saudi' unified portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa); select IMSIU as preferred university.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload all required documents (translated into Arabic if applicable) and submit electronic application.
Step 4 (January - March): IMSIU Deanship of Admissions conducts academic credential screening and ranks applicants against bilateral quotas.
Step 5 (April - May): University forwards recommended candidate list to Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs for security and administrative approval.
Step 6 (June - July): Final scholarship award notifications issued; Saudi MOE issues official electronic visa approval number.
Step 7 (July - August): Submit passport to Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Consulate-General in Karachi for Student Visa stamping; university dispatches flight e-ticket.
Step 8 (Late August / Early September): Arrival at King Khalid International Airport (Riyadh); university reception team provides airport transfer to campus housing.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated government application: Admission to IMSIU for international students automatically includes full government scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters from recognized academic teachers or community scholars uploaded as scanned documents.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation Statement (Arabic or English): Explain educational aspirations, religious character, and future academic and career objectives.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduate applicants. For Master's/PhD: 2-3 page research outline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Brief academic CV listing educational qualifications, grades, and language skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Interviews are generally not conducted; selection is document and credential based.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None required. Qudurat / Tahsili tests are not required for external international applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Saudi Cultural Mission and Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Pakistan upon selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified Arabic translation for all English/Urdu educational documents and police certificate.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the unified Study in Saudi portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport info page valid for at least two years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure Pakistani passport has at least 6 blank pages for visa and entry stamps.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Secondary School Certificate & Detailed Mark Sheet
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official matriculation and intermediate (HSSC) certificates and mark sheets.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC and MOFA Pakistan, with certified Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive medical fitness certificate certifying freedom from infectious diseases (HIV, Hepatitis B/C, TB).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Completed at an authorized GAMCA / GCC approved medical center in Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Police Character Certificate certifying applicant has no criminal record.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Recommendation letters from prominent teachers, professors, or recognized scholars.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Certified letters highlighting applicant's academic dedication and moral character.
Nadra Birth Certificate attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual application intake cycle running for Fall semester enrollment.

selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Referee attestations of character and academic aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: IMSIU International Admissions Committee, Saudi Ministry of Education Scholarship Board, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Quota-based merit ranking: Applications are ranked by academic percentage within country quota allocations (40 seats for Pakistan). Shortlisted candidates undergo ministry background check and final approval by Saudi Ministry of Education.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~8,000 to 12,000 international applicants across all participating countries
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~26.0% (Dedicated bilateral quota of ~40 seats gives strong odds to well-qualified Pakistani applicants)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 80%+ in Pakistani Intermediate (HSSC / Pre-Engineering / ICS) or 3.30+ CGPA for Master's
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Strong academic record, clean disciplinary and medical history, complete Arabic-translated and attested document dossier.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from across Pakistan (Punjab, Sindh, KPK, Balochistan, AJK) with Intermediate certificates from recognized BISE boards.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Sudan

fake_websites_and_scams: Fraudulent visa agents claiming to sell IMSIU scholarship visas for high fees. Saudi government scholarships are 100% free and strictly processed via the official Study in Saudi portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Saudi government scholarships have ZERO application fees. Any entity asking for money is fraudulent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not use brokers or agents; personal submission through the government portal is free and easy.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Medical examination at GAMCA approved center in Pakistan (~PKR 15,000 - 22,000).
Document attestation fees at IBCC, MOFA, and Arabic translation bureaus (~PKR 25,000 - 40,000).
Initial out-of-pocket cash needed upon arrival in Riyadh before first stipend disbursement (~SAR 500 to 1,000; ~PKR 38,000 to 76,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Computer Science is taught in Arabic. (FACT: Coursework in the College of Computer and Information Sciences is 100% in English).
CLAIM: You must know Arabic to apply for STEM. (FACT: Zero Arabic knowledge required for computer science and engineering).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial agents claim scholarships can be transferred between universities in Saudi Arabia; official regulations strictly forbid transferring scholarships between Saudi institutions.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA of 2.75 / 5.00 (Good standing) throughout degree studies; GPA below threshold results in academic warning and potential stipend suspension.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory regular attendance in all lectures; unexcused absence exceeding 20% leads to course denial.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester academic performance reviews reported to the Deanship of Admissions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Students on scholarship visa (Iqama) are strictly prohibited from taking outside commercial employment in the Kingdom.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars must depart the Kingdom upon completion of their degree program within the period specified by Saudi regulations (typically 3 months post-graduation).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or repayment requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled upon academic dismissal or violation of university regulations; past disbursed funds are not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another university within Saudi Arabia is strictly prohibited for external scholarship recipients.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing majors is permitted only within the same college during the first academic year subject to dean approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship duration cannot be extended beyond one additional semester past standard degree timeline without special Ministry of Education approval.
